In a lighter vein, he sang lead vocals on the popular "California Raisins" claymation TV commercials and recorded two California Raisins R&B albums.

The lyrics refer to a club near Seattle, where Hendrix sometimes played early in his career.  The song was a staple of live shows.  Several live recordings were released after Hendrix's death.

Lost in Paradise (song) | "Lost in Paradise" is a song by American rock band Evanescence from their third self-titled studio album, "Evanescence" (2011).
